title: Positive polarity versus dark mode reading performance
statement:
Positive polarity (dark text on light background) yields faster reading times and fewer errors under normal ambient lighting than negative polarity (dark mode).

Options:
- High Ambient Legibility: Positive Polarity (Light Mode) (fits: daytime use, long reading)
- Low Ambient Glare Reduction: Negative Polarity (Dark Mode) (fits: night use, developer tools)
- Contextual Optimization: Adaptive Polarity (fits: system default sync)
appliesWhen: Applies to: reading apps, typography, automotive ui. Audience: general, seniors.

source.title: Effects of ambient illumination, contrast polarity, and letter size on text legibility
source.authors: Jonathan Dobres; Nadine Chahine; Bruce Reimer; David Mehler
